pitch.text: Meet Ordo, the AI maintenance engineer for your codebase, built on IBM Bob 2.0.

Technical debt grows quietly. It piles up unseen, until it becomes an outage, slow delivery, or a security incident. Today's scanners produce long, noisy reports, ranked by rule severity, with no business context and no fix path. So the list gets ignored.
Ordo closes that gap in one pass. Running on IBM Bob 2.0, Bob scans a GitHub repository, detects the debt, ranks every finding by real risk, and prepares the fix, the tests, and the pull request.

Bob does the heavy lifting. It runs the analysis and ranks every finding by urgency, business impact, and fix effort, with IBM watsonx dot AI assisting on the scoring and plain English explanations. Let's see it live.

demo.text: This is Ordo's web app, running on Vercel. We'll have Bob scan a real project, Agora, straight from GitHub.
I click Scan Repo Now and paste the repository link. Bob takes over, reading the code through the GitHub API and running five debt detectors, live.
Seconds later, the dashboard. Bob found twenty issues, all of them high urgency, each ranked for urgency, impact, and effort, with watsonx helping to explain why.
The overview breaks the debt down by category, shows repository stats, including zero test files, and lists the top issues.
Bob then sequences everything into a roadmap. An overall assessment, then three phases the team can schedule.
Open any issue to drill in. Ask why it is ranked here, and Bob explains its reasoning in plain English.
Then generate the fix. Bob returns a step by step remediation plan, code hints, a testing strategy, and a pull request summary, ready to copy straight into GitHub with one click.
Under the hood, this is IBM Bob 2.0. Ordo ships as a custom Bob mode with three skills, analyze repo, explain issue, and generate fix. Bob runs the scan and detection, with watsonx dot AI assisting.
And the full pitch deck is one click away, under Docs.

close.text: Ordo, built on IBM Bob 2.0, turns software chaos into order. Try it today at ordo with bob dot vercel dot app.
